summary: Every valid result explicitly contains mn grid characters, establishing an output-size lower bound that the one-write-per-character construction matches.

optimality.argument: Any correct implementation must materialize m strings of n characters, while the accepted construction creates exactly those mn characters and performs only constant additional work per row.

replacement_checks.evidence: The required return value contains exactly m times n independently addressable grid characters, so writing the output costs Omega(mn) time.
The reference emits one n-character top row and m - 1 rows consisting of n - 1 obstacles plus one free cell, for O(mn) total character construction.
The certificate regression checks both stored source forms with an independent monotone-path dynamic program for all 625 legal dimension pairs from 1 by 1 through 25 by 25.
